title: ERP Rates Cut by S$1 at 12 Locations for the December School Holidays (23 Nov-31 Dec 2026), Then Two Rise From 4 Jan - https://www.misslobang.com/

ERP Rates Cut by S$1 at 12 Locations for the December School Holidays (23 Nov-31 Dec 2026), Then Two Rise From 4 Jan | MissLobang Miss Lobang Food Deals Lifestyle News Kids 中文 News ERP Rates Cut by S$1 at 12 Locations for the December School Holidays (23 Nov-31 Dec 2026), Then Two Rise From 4 Jan
 LTA will cut ERP rates by S$1 at 12 locations across 31 time slots on the AYE, CTE, PIE, KPE and MCE from 23 November to 31 December 2026, with ten slots falling to S$0. Normal rates return on 4 January 2027, when two slots also rise by S$1. Full gantry-by-gantry table.
 Marcus Wong 16 November 2026 4 min read Good news for anyone still driving to work over the year-end break. LTA is cutting ERP rates by S$1 at 12 locations across 31 time slots from Monday 23 November to Thursday 31 December 2026 , and ten of those slots drop all the way to S$0 . The catch comes after the holidays: from Monday 4 January 2027 , the normal rates return and two slots go up by S$1 . 
 > Quick view: S$1 off at 12 ERP locations (AYE, CTE, PIE, KPE, MCE) in 31 time slots, 23 Nov to 31 Dec 2026. Ten slots become free. Rates revert on 4 Jan 2027, when PIE (Kallang Bahru) 8.30am-9am rises to S$5 and Northbound CTE before PIE 5pm-5.30pm rises to S$1. 
 LTA announced the changes on 16 November 2026 after its latest quarterly review, saying the locations and time slots were picked "in anticipation of lower traffic demand" while schools are out. 
 The December holiday cuts, gantry by gantry 
 All rates below are per Passenger Car Unit, which is what a car, taxi or light goods vehicle pays. 
 Location Time Now 23 Nov to 31 Dec 
 AYE before Alexandra (towards City) 9am-9.30am S$1 S$0

 7.30am-8am S$2 S$1

 8am-8.30am S$4 S$3 
 8.30am-9am S$5 S$4 
 9am-9.30am S$4 S$3 
 9.30am-10am S$3 S$2

 Westbound PIE before Eunos Link 7.30am-8am S$1 S$0 
 Every other slot, at these and all other gantries, stays at its current rate. 
 The two increases from 4 January 2027 
 LTA says traffic built up along several expressway stretches in October 2026, so two slots rise by S$1 once the holiday rates end: 
 Location Time Now From 4 Jan 2027 
 PIE (Kallang Bahru and slip road into Bendemeer, 2 gantries) 8.30am-9am S$4 S$5 
 Northbound CTE before PIE 5pm-5.30pm S$0 S$1 
 Note the timing. The holiday cuts end on 31 December, and LTA says rates revert from 4 January 2027. That is the first Monday of the new year, after the New Year's Day public holiday and the weekend. 
 What else LTA is watching 
 Orchard on Saturdays. Weekday ERP returned to the Orchard Cordon on 7 September. LTA says Saturday speeds in Orchard have stayed below the optimal 20-30km/h since October 2025, and it will assess whether to resume Saturday charging next quarter . Nothing changes for now. 
 Two possible new charging points. LTA has seen persistently slow traffic at the CTE (SLE) near the Braddell Road entry and the KPE (MCE) near the Airport Road entry . If the congestion persists, it says it will introduce ERP charging at these new locations. 
 What it means for you 
 Morning AYE, CTE and KPE drivers save the most. A daily KPE run through Defu Flyover at 8.30am drops from S$6 to S$5, and the AYE after Jurong Town Hall at 7.30am from S$5 to S$4. Between 23 November and 31 December there are 27 working weekdays (Christmas Day is a public holiday), so one pass a day saves up to S$27 per slot. 
 Some trips become free. Ten slots, mostly at the shoulders of the peak (such as 7am-7.30am on the KPE or 7.30pm-8pm on Northbound CTE after PIE), cost nothing until 31 December. 
 Budget for January. If you use the PIE at Kallang Bahru between 8.30am and 9am, your charge goes to S$5 from 4 January 2027. Northbound CTE before PIE becomes priced at S$1 between 5pm and 5.30pm, a slot that is free today. 
 Year-end road trips north are a separate story. If you are heading to Malaysia, expect heavy traffic at Woodlands and Tuas during the school holidays. 
 *ERP rates are reviewed quarterly and can change. Check the current rate for your route and vehicle type on LTA's website or OneMotoring before you drive. Rates for motorcycles, heavier vehicles and buses are derived from the per-car figures above using LTA's vehicle multipliers.* 
 *Source: Land Transport Authority, Revised ERP Rates from 23 November 2026 , news release dated 16 November 2026. Cover graphic by MissLobang.*

 Frequently Asked Questions
 When do the December 2026 ERP reductions start and end? + They apply from Monday 23 November to Thursday 31 December 2026, inclusive. LTA says rates revert to the prevailing ERP rates from Monday 4 January 2027, the first working Monday after the New Year's Day public holiday and the weekend.
 Which ERP slots become free during the holidays? + Ten slots drop to S$0: AYE before Alexandra 9am-9.30am; Northbound CTE after PIE 7.30pm-8pm; Northbound CTE before PIE 6pm-6.30pm and 6.30pm-7pm; MCE Eastbound near Central Boulevard 6.30pm-7pm; KPE (ECP) after Defu Flyover 7am-7.30am and 9.30am-10am; PIE (Adam and Mount Pleasant) 9am-9.30am; PIE (Kallang Bahru) 7am-7.30am; and Westbound PIE before Eunos Link 7.30am-8am.
 Which ERP rates go up in January 2027? + Two slots rise by S$1 from 4 January 2027: PIE (Kallang Bahru and slip road into Bendemeer) between 8.30am and 9am goes from S$4 to S$5, and Northbound CTE before PIE between 5pm and 5.30pm goes from S$0 to S$1. LTA cited traffic build-up it observed in October 2026. It is also assessing Saturday charging in Orchard next quarter and may add new charging points near the Braddell Road entry to the CTE (SLE) and the Airport Road entry to the KPE (MCE) if congestion persists.
